snippet.title: Pop n' Pop - PC Version Intro
snippet.description:
Pop n' Pop - PC Version Intro

the pc version of pop n' pop is weird. couldn't tell you exactly who the developer was- the only ones credited on that end are taito themselves and dreams- but the publisher was vektorlogic, a uk-based company that mostly dealt with coin-op hardware and the like. 

it is a strange port. from the outset it looks like the ps1 port, but a few modes (challenge and family) are gone, the hidden characters (chack'n, hipopo, dreg) seem to be missing, and the graphics are... well, the sprites have been resized and look like they've been smoothed, and movements are almost like they're done in flash (i.e. they move in straight lines, almost, whereas in the ps1 port they look like they're done more by-hand). it's hard to describe. also, the game seems a lot faster and it's harder to chain combos together like in the ps1 version, but this may just be because i'm on a keyboard as the game refuses to recognise my controller.

anyway... possibly to cover up the fact that a few characters are missing, the game's intro was redone. we present it without comment.
